data.name: spaces
constraints: CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0)
CHECK (manual_balance IS NULL OR CAST(manual_balance AS REAL) >= 0)
CHECK (max_members IS NULL OR max_members >= 0)

data.name: user_profiles
constraints: CHECK (length(trim(nickname)) > 0)

data.name: categories
constraints: CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0)

data.name: budget_periods
constraints: CHECK (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date)
CHECK (window_end IS NULL OR window_start IS NULL OR window_end >= window_start)
CHECK (budget_target IS NULL OR CAST(budget_target AS REAL) >= 0)

data.name: income_recurrence_rules
constraints: CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0)
CHECK (amount IS NULL OR CAST(amount AS REAL) > 0)
CHECK (fixed_day IS NULL OR (fixed_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31))
CHECK (date_range_start IS NULL OR (date_range_start BETWEEN 1 AND 31))
CHECK (date_range_end IS NULL OR (date_range_end BETWEEN 1 AND 31))
CHECK (boundary_count IS NULL OR boundary_count > 0)
CHECK (schedule_type <> 'fixedDate' OR fixed_day IS NOT NULL)
CHECK (schedule_type <> 'weekdayRule' OR (weekday_ordinal IS NOT NULL AND weekday_day IS NOT NULL))
CHECK (schedule_type <> 'dateRange' OR (date_range_start IS NOT NULL AND date_range_end IS NOT NULL))
CHECK (schedule_type <> 'boundaryDays' OR (boundary_anchor IS NOT NULL AND boundary_count IS NOT NULL))

data.name: incomes
constraints: CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0)
CHECK (amount IS NULL OR CAST(amount AS REAL) > 0)

data.name: payments
constraints: CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "budget_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "country_code" TEXT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "max_members" INTEGER NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "manual_balance" TEXT NULL, "manual_balance_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "min_schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "feed_order_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'grouped', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0), CHECK (manual_balance IS NULL OR CAST(manual_balance AS REAL) >= 0), CHECK (max_members IS NULL OR max_members >= 0));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "space_members" ("space_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "joined_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("space_id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "member_local_labels" ("is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "last_modified_by" TEXT NULL, "client_edited_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces (id), "viewer_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_name" TEXT NULL, "local_role" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("space_id", "viewer_user_id", "target_user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profiles" ("is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "last_modified_by" TEXT NULL, "client_edited_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nickname" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id"), CHECK (length(trim(nickname)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "last_modified_by" TEXT NULL, "client_edited_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "expense_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'variable', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_periods" ("is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "last_modified_by" TEXT NULL, "client_edited_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces (id), "period_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "window_start" TEXT NULL, "window_end" TEXT NULL, "anchor_date" TEXT NULL, "holiday_data_incomplete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("holiday_data_incomplete" IN (0, 1)), "deadline_date" TEXT NULL, "deadline_is_hard" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deadline_is_hard" IN (0, 1)), "budget_target" TEXT NULL, "unfrozen_until" TEXT NULL, "unfreeze_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date), CHECK (window_end IS NULL OR window_start IS NULL OR window_end >= window_start), CHECK (budget_target IS NULL OR CAST(budget_target AS REAL) >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "income_recurrence_rules" ("is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "last_modified_by" TEXT NULL, "client_edited_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" TEXT NULL, "is_anchor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_anchor" IN (0, 1)), "schedule_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "fixed_day" INTEGER NULL, "weekday_ordinal" TEXT NULL, "weekday_day" TEXT NULL, "date_range_start" INTEGER NULL, "date_range_end" INTEGER NULL, "boundary_anchor" TEXT NULL, "boundary_count" INTEGER NULL, "country_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0), CHECK (amount IS NULL OR CAST(amount AS REAL) > 0), CHECK (fixed_day IS NULL OR (fixed_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31)), CHECK (date_range_start IS NULL OR (date_range_start BETWEEN 1 AND 31)), CHECK (date_range_end IS NULL OR (date_range_end BETWEEN 1 AND 31)), CHECK (boundary_count IS NULL OR boundary_count > 0), CHECK (schedule_type <> 'fixedDate' OR fixed_day IS NOT NULL), CHECK (schedule_type <> 'weekdayRule' OR (weekday_ordinal IS NOT NULL AND weekday_day IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (schedule_type <> 'dateRange' OR (date_range_start IS NOT NULL AND date_range_end IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (schedule_type <> 'boundaryDays' OR (boundary_anchor IS NOT NULL AND boundary_count IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "incomes" ("is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "last_modified_by" TEXT NULL, "client_edited_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces (id), "recurrence_rule_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES income_recurrence_rules (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" TEXT NULL, "expected_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "actual_date" TEXT NULL, "budget_period_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES budget_periods (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_paid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_paid" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0), CHECK (amount IS NULL OR CAST(amount AS REAL) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "last_modified_by" TEXT NULL, "client_edited_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_received_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces (id), "budget_period_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES budget_periods (id), "period_assignment" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "group_recurring_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "expense_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_paid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_paid" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0), CHECK (CAST(amount AS REAL) >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "holiday_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "country_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "holiday_dates" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("country_code", "year"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_non_working_days" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "country_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("date", "country_code"));
